name: agentic-rag-assistant
description: Root convenience scripts only - the actual server/ and client/ packages are independent, this just saves running two terminals by hand. See README.md's Local Setup section for the full walkthrough (env vars, Supabase/Pinecone setup, etc.) - this alone isn't enough to get a working app without those configured first.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
